reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Expanded Comprehensive Response to HIV/AIDS in Timor-Leste - Timor-Leste (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Timor-Leste, HIV, Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste (MOH)This program has the following goals: End HIV transmission, stop people dying from AIDS and control STIs for a healthy Timor-Leste.. The objectives of this program are: 90% of key populations and vulnerable groups in Timor-Leste will be reached with information and have knowledge about HIV and how to prevent it, by 2021.. 80% of people from key population groups will report using a condom in last sexual contacts, by 2021.. 90% of people living with HIV will know their status, by 2021.. HIV testing will be provided to 100% of people seeking STI treatment services and 100% of people with TB and they will all know their status, by 2021.. 90% of all people living with HIV will receive antiretroviral treatment, by 2021.. 90% of the people on antiretroviral therapy will have their viral load tested at least annually and will be virally suppressed, by 2021.. At least 90% of woman presenting for antenatal care will be tested for HIV in pregnancy, by 2021.. 100% of pregnant woman found to be HIV positive will receive antiretroviral treatment in pregnancy, by 2021.. 100% of exposed infants will be tested for HIV at 6, 12 and 18 months, by 2021.. 100% of babies born to exposed mothers will be provided with antiretroviral treatment in the first months of life, by 2021.
